temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites him to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is a dedicated friend and professional, but he has growing concern that Gary is overworking and harming his health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's refusal confirms his workload is severe and he is currently prioritizing hospital obligations over rest.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is seriously overworked and at risk of burnout, and he may resist or be unable to take a break.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary recognize the health risks and encourage him to accept rest or support, possibly by finding another way to intervene.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary admits it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is mainly caused by hospital obligations, though he is still worried about Gary's health and hopes the retreat may help him relax.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's restlessness, avoidance, and admission suggest the problem is deeper than professional workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with a complicated personal or emotional burden beyond work, and he has been hiding it to avoid burdening Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently, listen without judgment, and encourage him to share what is really going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He agrees that help organizing his schedule could be useful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is carrying a hidden, complicated burden that is more than ordinary work stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now understands the specific causes: new department pressures plus personal challenges. Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is understandable given his circumstances, and he can improve if he prioritizes tasks, delegates, and accepts support to regain balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary find a better work-life balance by planning priorities, delegating responsibilities, and organizing his schedule.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is less overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is trying to improve and can benefit from continued support, though challenges may remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reports and efforts confirm that meaningful progress is happening.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making real progress toward a healthier balance and is less overwhelmed, though continued encouragement may still help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels much more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has made substantial progress but may still benefit from ongoing support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's successful adjustment and sense of control show he can manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of maintaining a healthier balance on his own and no longer needs active intervention from Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfaction and happiness for his friend
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support while letting Gary know he remains available if needed.
